about.title: About KaarYab Afghanistan
about.body: KaarYab brings together jobs, internships, scholarships, online courses, and remote work opportunities for Afghan youth in one place. Our goal is to make access to these opportunities simpler and more transparent.
about.valueOnePlaceDesc: All opportunity types gathered in one searchable list.
about.valueYouthDesc: Designed to surface roles and pathways relevant to Afghan youth.
about.valueGrowingDesc: We curate and add new opportunities regularly.
about.missionBody: To make opportunity discovery easy and equitable for Afghan youth by curating reliable listings, simplifying application journeys, and partnering with organizations committed to youth employment and learning.
about.teamIntro: A small cross-functional team focused on product, data and partnerships.
about.timeline1Body: KaarYab was founded to bridge information gaps and make opportunities discoverable.
about.timeline2Body: We launched a public beta with curated listings and feedback loops.
about.timeline3Body: Partnerships and content expanded to better serve job seekers and learners.
